passages.w: Beyond Good and Evil
passages.s: Everything is so arranged that the worst of all tastes, THE TASTE FOR THE UNCONDITIONAL, is cruelly befooled and abused, until a man learns to introduce a little art into his sentiments, and prefers to try conclusions with the artificial, as do the real artists of life.

src.work: Beyond Good and Evil

passages.w: Beyond Good and Evil
passages.s: Among men, as among all other animals, there is a surplus of defective, diseased, degenerating, infirm, and necessarily suffering individuals; the successful cases, among men also, are always the exception; and in view of the fact that man is THE ANIMAL NOT YET PROPERLY ADAPTED TO HIS ENVIRONMENT, the rare exception.

src.work: Beyond Good and Evil

passages.w: Beyond Good and Evil
passages.s: People have always to be born to a high station, or, more definitely, they have to be BRED for it: a person has only a right to philosophy--taking the word in its higher significance--in virtue of his descent; the ancestors, the "blood," decide here also.

passages.w: Beyond Good and Evil
passages.s: One ought even to ENCOURAGE them, as has been partially attempted in the following rhymes:-- Hail, ye worthies, barrow-wheeling, "Longer--better," aye revealing, Stiffer aye in head and knee; Unenraptured, never jesting, Mediocre everlasting, SANS GENIE ET SANS ESPRIT!

src.work: Beyond Good and Evil

passages.w: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism
passages.s: My brother was very anxious to take some decisive step to help him, and, laying the plans of his great work on Greece aside, he selected a small portion from the already completed manuscript--a portion dealing with one distinct side of Hellenism,--to wit, its tragic art.

src.work: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism

tr.fr: Mon frère était très désireux de prendre quelque mesure décisive pour l'aider, et, laissant de côté les plans de son grand ouvrage sur la Grèce, il en choisit une petite partie du manuscrit déjà terminé, une partie traitant d'un côté distinct de l'hellénisme, à savoir, son art tragique.

passages.w: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism
passages.s: I will dream on!" I have likewise been told of persons capable of continuing the causality of one and the same dream for three and even more successive nights: all of which facts clearly testify that our innermost being, the common substratum of all of us, experiences our dreams with deep joy and cheerful acquiescence.

src.work: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism

tr.fr: Je vais continuer à rêver ! » On m’a également parlé de personnes capables de perpétuer la causalité d’un seul et même rêve pendant trois nuits successives, voire plus : tous ces faits témoignent clairement que notre être le plus profond, le substrat commun de nous tous, vit nos rêves avec une joie profonde et un acquiescement joyeux.

passages.w: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism

passages.w: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism

src.work: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism

passages.w: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism
passages.s: And even as tragedy, with its metaphysical comfort, points to the eternal life of this kernel of existence, notwithstanding the perpetual dissolution of phenomena, so the symbolism of the satyric chorus already expresses figuratively this primordial relation between the thing in itself and phenomenon.

src.work: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism

tr.fr: Et de même que la tragédie, avec son réconfort métaphysique, désigne la vie éternelle de ce noyau d'existence, malgré la dissolution perpétuelle des phénomènes, de même le symbolisme du chœur satyrique exprime déjà au sens figuré ce rapport primordial entre la chose en soi et le phénomène.

passages.w: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism

passages.w: The Birth of Tragedy; or, Hellenism and Pessimism
